en: GSC window 18 Jul→14 Aug (all 28 rows of the Days tab summed by hand for the exact total instead of the rounded '1.75K' tile; the hand-summed clicks total of 77 matches the Total clicks tile and the hand-computed CTR of 4.40% matches the 4.4% tile): impressions 1,521→1,604→1,749, queries-with-impressions 147→154, and average position improved again 29.6→29.2 — the best position recorded to date.

BUT clicks FELL 87→77 (−10) and CTR dropped 5.4%→4.4%. This is the first clear decline in clicks. The cause is the rolling window: today's window pushed out the three days 15–17 Jul and pulled in 12–14 Aug, and those three new days contributed only 4 clicks (12 Aug: 1, 13 Aug: 2, 14 Aug: 1) while the three days that dropped off took 14 clicks with them.
Reminder: GSC and GA4 are rolling 28-day windows. Every delta against 14 Aug is the window shifting, NOT any single day's traffic.

The real bright spot is coverage: queries-with-impressions recovered 147→154, reversing the 153→147 contraction flagged on 14 Aug. Impressions rose by 145 while average position still improved — the footprint is widening again rather than shrinking.

Brand structure eased slightly: 'dxliving' 51→45 clicks, 'dx living' 24→20. Brand totals moved 75→65 clicks, which is 84.4% of all 77 clicks (86.2% on 14 Aug) — the brand share narrowed by 1.8 points, but only because brand lost clicks faster, not because non-brand earned any.

All 8 non-brand queries in the top 10 still return EXACTLY ZERO CLICKS — unchanged for weeks. Two things are worth noting: '3d renders for builders melbourne' improved sharply 28.3→23.1, the best non-brand rank recorded so far; and 'interior finishing' (32 impressions, position 39.8) is a NEW entrant to the top 10. But the group as a whole still sits in the 23–50 band, too deep to earn clicks.

GA4 — A PARTIAL RECOVERY SIGNAL, THE FIRST IN 19 DAYS. Measured today: 3–9 Aug = 1 session, but 10–16 Aug = 13 sessions. Narrowed further: 10–12 Aug = 1 session, 13–14 Aug = 6 sessions. Hits therefore began returning around 13 Aug.

HOWEVER, checked directly on the live HOMEPAGE today the picture is IDENTICAL to 14 Aug: still 4 GTM snippet copies, 7 raw gtm.js occurrences in outerHTML, 2 <noscript> iframes, the GTM-PZ9N8QTR container, the #dx-analytics-dedupe script still intact, __dxGtmLoaded still true, 0 script tags loaded, gtag and google_tag_manager still undefined, dataLayer still a single entry, still no G- measurement ID. The homepage is STILL BROKEN.

These two observations contradict each other if the homepage were the only source. Both are recorded here as observed; no cause is guessed. Next steps: establish which template has been sending hits since 13 Aug, and still delete #dx-analytics-dedupe to fix the homepage.

CONSEQUENTLY: every 28-day GA4 figure in this snapshot (sessions 153, engaged 96, key events 9, users 83, total events 1,086) is STILL an under-count — the 20 Jul–16 Aug window contains almost the whole 29 Jul–12 Aug outage. The drop against 14 Aug (174/118/13/97/1,224) is NOT a traffic decline. Data from 29 Jul to 12 Aug is permanently lost.

AI assistant channel: still exactly 1 session from chatgpt.com / ai-assistant (0.65% of total), 100% engagement, 15 seconds, 7 events, 0 key events — no Perplexity, Gemini or Copilot appears anywhere in the source/medium table (all 10 rows read).

Ahrefs ACCELERATED sharply: referring domains 410→422 (+12, all-time 425→437), backlinks 422→438 (+16, all-time 447→462). This is the largest single-scan gain since 10 Aug. Quality also kept improving: followed referring domains 6→8 and followed backlinks 6→8. The base is still very thin though — 8 of 422 domains followed = 1.9%. DR still 0, organic keywords and traffic still 0.

Health Score held at 100 (fresh crawl today at 04:28, 14 URLs, 0 errors). Crawled pages in Site Explorer jumped 102→121. The 404 count was NOT fully enumerated today (121-row table, only the first page read), so it is recorded as null rather than guessed.

AI citations hold at a TOTAL of 18 for an eighth consecutive day, but the mix CHANGED: ChatGPT 10→12 (+2) while Copilot 8→6 (−2). Cited-page counts are unchanged (ChatGPT 3, Copilot 2). AI Overviews, AI Mode, Gemini and Perplexity remain 0; Grok is paused by Ahrefs so it is recorded as null, not 0.

AI Visibility holds at 26/100. All 5 measurable dimensions are unchanged: Presence 2/10, Citation surface 1/10, Technical readiness 9/10 (6 of 7 signals, only llms.txt missing), Measurement 1/10. Third-party corpus stays at 0/10 but was NOT re-tested today and is flagged as such.
